liveValues.heat: 0..1, mood target, default 0.2; scales eye glow and engine steam

brokenFlag: rig.state.broken = { 'hound-fangs': true, 'hound-snout': true, 'hound-haunch': true } draws ink cracks and missing chunks with an ember interior at each anchor, in any mood (the fangs get a patch on each tooth row so each follows its jaw)
pulse: rig.pulse() plays the magnet shimmer at the snout (flat teal ink-edged arcs); idle fires it once per loop, attack during the windup
